_comment: Workbook exercise plant-heat-pump, the resolution lesson: heatpump_defrost and compressor_staging on the same 5-minute data resampled to 15 minutes. A resampled reversing valve or stage is the bin's mean; a 5-minute defrost in a 15-minute bin reads 0.67, which CAMBER counts as two reversals, the fewest the bin allows. Both rules need a trend of 5 minutes or finer (max_interval_min): coarser, a count is a floor. ASHP__defrost_sensor still faults (49.89 a day) with a caveat saying so; the other units, and every stage count, decline to info ('cannot confirm on a 15-minute trend') because part-way samples show the interval hid changes.
